entries.label: Dite — avant-poste de Frostbite
entries.scene: The Frostbite boss location in Metal Gear Survive's African Dite region, matching the actual screenshots, with the creature and player OMITTED. It is NOT a snow or ice arena. Sparse low rectangular battered grey-plaster outpost buildings with small black square windows, rusty corrugated metal sheet roofs, chainlink fences with bent tops, rough reddish dirt and broken pale stone, thin dry grass. Heavy dull grey Dust fog obscures the distance, open overcast sky takes the upper half. Use one level reddish dirt foreground lane with the low corrugated outpost buildings and fencing behind it. No invented ice, crystal palace, Arctic mountains or blue neon glow.

notes: Avant-poste africain contrôlé : petits bâtiments abîmés à tôle, clôtures, terre rouge et poussière grise.
